_published_faq.name: How do I add Tavily to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tavily to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Tavily MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Tavily scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tavily MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tavily provides these MCP tools: tavily_search, tavily_extract, tavily_crawl, tavily_map, and tavily_research.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tavily?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Tavily in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.
